sourceNote: ElectionsIreland.org files this contest under its later area name "Finglas" (cons 119). In 1974 Dublin Corporation was elected in nine numbered areas, set by the Dublin County Borough (Electoral Areas) Order, 1974 (S.I. No. 28 of 1974); this is Dublin City Number Three, the area named for Finglas, filed under IrelandElection.com's name for it.
